# typesense_synonym_set (Resource)

A global synonym set (Typesense v30+). Collections opt in via the `synonym_sets` collection attribute. Replaces the legacy per-collection `typesense_synonym` resource that was removed in v30. See the [Typesense API docs](https://typesense.org/docs/30.2/api/synonyms.html).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "typesense_synonym_set" "clothing" {
  name = "clothing"

  items {
    id       = "outerwear"
    synonyms = ["coat", "blazer", "jacket"]
  }

  items {
    id       = "sneaker_1way"
    root     = "sneaker"
    synonyms = ["shoe", "running shoe"]
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `items` (Block Set) Synonym items in the set. Each item has its own id and synonym list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--items))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

<a id="nestedblock--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Required:

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the synonym item within this set.
- `synonyms` (Set of String) Words that should be considered synonyms.

Optional:

- `locale` (String) Locale for the synonym (leave blank to use the standard tokenizer).
- `root` (String) For 1-way synonyms, the root word that the words in `synonyms` map to.
- `symbols_to_index` (Set of String) Special characters to keep when indexing synonyms.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
terraform import typesense_synonym_set.clothing clothing
```
